## Checks

- [ ] `make all` passes (frontmatter, i18n parity, audit, links)
- [ ] New notes are linked from their module README
- [ ] Numbers carry ONTAP version, region, and configuration
- [ ] `evidence` tier matches the actual supporting evidence
- [ ] Tier 1 docs updated in every language listed in `docs/i18n-manifest.txt`
- [ ] No company names, personal names, real identifiers, or internal ticket IDs
- [ ] No vendor-versus framing; trade-offs stated symmetrically
- [ ] No role/persona-labeled callouts (use neutral topic labels)

## Self-review (4-axis)

- [ ] **Implementation gaps** — nothing in scope left out
- [ ] **Oddities** — no leftover placeholders or half-applied renames
- [ ] **Polish** — in-scope small improvements included
- [ ] **Regression risk** — no moved link targets, no stale citations of changed numbers
